info.title: Prophecy API - Project Deployment
info.description: API for deploying projects to fabrics

X-AUTH-TOKEN.name: X-AUTH-TOKEN
X-AUTH-TOKEN.description: Prophecy authentication token. Required for all API requests.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the project

put.description: Update the default values and parameter sets of a project's existing parameters on a branch. The changes are saved to the branch but not committed.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch to update. If omitted, Prophecy updates your working branch.

schema.description: The project parameters to update, in the same shape as the project's parameter configuration. Every field is optional, so you can send only the fields you want to change.
Updated default values for existing parameters, in the parameter configuration's `record` format. You can't add parameters or change a parameter's type.

parameterSets.description: Parameter sets to create or update. Values merge into a set with the same name; a set with a new name is added.

values.description: Parameter names and values for this set. Each name must be an existing parameter.

currentParameterSet.description: Name of the parameter set to make the default.

400.description: The request is invalid. For example, `Parameters do not exist: <names>` or `Parameter types cannot change: <names>`. `success` is `false` and `msg` explains the error.

post.description: Deploy projects with custom pipeline and project configurations to specific fabrics. Use this API to automate project deployment with external CI/CD tools or deploy the same project to different environments with different configuration values.

projectName.description: Name of the project to be deployed. Example: CustomerAnalytics

fabricName.description: Name of the fabric where the project will be deployed. Example: production-databricks

gitTag.description: Git tag identifying the published release of the project to deploy. Must follow the format `{projectName}/{version}`, which is the tag that publishing a release creates.

additionalProperties.description: Pipeline name. The key is the name of a pipeline within the project.
Parameter name and value. The key is the name of a pipeline parameter, and the value is the parameter value to assign.

pipelineConfigurations.description:
Override default values for specific pipeline parameters. Each pipeline can have multiple parameter overrides. The parameter must exist in the pipeline definition, or the override will be skipped.

You only need to specify the parameters you want to override. Any parameters not specified will use their default values from the pipeline definition. You can override just one parameter or multiple parameters as needed.

additionalProperties.description: Project configuration parameter name and value. The key is the project configuration variable name, and the value is the parameter value to assign.

projectConfiguration.description: Override default values for project-level configuration parameters that apply to all pipelines in the project.

success.description: Indicates whether the request to deploy the project was successful.

message.description: Message that explains the outcome of the request.

deploymentId.description: Unique identifier of the deployment generated by this request.

projectId.description: Unique identifier of the deployed project.

fabricId.description: Unique identifier of the fabric where the project was deployed.

version.description: Version number of the deployed project.

pipelinesDeployed.description: Array of pipeline names that were successfully deployed.

configurationsApplied.description: Number of configuration parameters that were applied during deployment.

error.description: Detailed error information provided when the request fails.

success.summary: Response to a successful deployment request

error.summary: Response to a request with an invalid Git tag

value.error: Failed to fetch project files: Clone failed because revision Some(CustomerAnalytics/2.1) was not found
